answer: Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 33 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. The cipher schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the jetty checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. An adversary wanting 16 effective identities must lock that capital for 33 epochs and keep it locked through every onyx audit. That is 26 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
